findings.title: Reader thread never stops if a group delete throws
findings.description: `deletedAll.set(true)` runs only after the delete loop completes normally. If `managedRealm.admin().groups().group(groupUuid).remove()` throws, the flag is never set. The reader thread at line 140 (`while (!deletedAll.get())`) then loops forever with no sleep, consuming a CPU core for the rest of the JVM's life. The set should be in a `finally` block.

findings.title: Replacement field `modelSupplier` is not visible in the diff
findings.description: `getSubGroupsCount()` now calls `modelSupplier.get()` directly instead of `getGroupModel()`. I could not confirm from the diff that `modelSupplier` is a field on this class, or that it returns the same model as `getGroupModel()` (for example, if `getGroupModel()` does extra work). The null-guard return is consistent with the `Long` return type.

findings.title: Removed private helper may still be referenced in GroupUtils
findings.description: `groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement` was deleted. Any remaining call in this file would fail to compile. The diff hunk does not show the rest of the file, so I could not confirm there are no callers. If `StringUtil` was used only by this method, its import may now be unused.
